blocker.summary: The shell supplemental proof surface is blocked by an accepted-source Windows compile break in crates/shell, while the PowerShell W2Only contradiction is tracked test drift rather than a start-forwarder product defect.
blocker.details:
Shell contradiction evidence: 'cargo build -p shell --lib' with CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside the checkout exited 101, so the package fails on Windows before any test harness is involved. The first actionable diagnostics were error[E0432] at 'crates/shell/src/repl/async_repl.rs:150' for an unconditional import of PreparedSpawnWorldWorkerBootstrap even though 'crates/shell/src/execution/orchestrator_world_dispatch.rs:1104' gates that type to linux/macos, error[E0412] at 'crates/shell/src/execution/agent_runtime/state_store.rs:3043' for an unconditional impl WorldWorkReceiptRegistry on a Windows build where the dependent world-work types are only in scope for linux/test, and error[E0433]/error[E0425] at 'crates/shell/src/execution/orchestrator_world_dispatch.rs:557-559' where fork_world_worker reaches PathBuf plus internal steering helpers that are cfg'd away on Windows. The exact tracked proof command 'cargo test -p shell "windows_tests::" -- --nocapture' also exited 101 and reproduced those same library-build failures before later lib-test-only Unix Permissions::from_mode errors, so the causal classification is 'accepted-source Windows build defect', not 'test-only cfg defect' and not 'overbroad evidence command'. Minimal owning increment/scope: package 'crates/shell', primarily 'crates/shell/src/repl/async_repl.rs', 'crates/shell/src/execution/agent_runtime/state_store.rs', and 'crates/shell/src/execution/orchestrator_world_dispatch.rs'.

PowerShell contradiction evidence: the direct tracked command 'pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/windows/prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1 -W2Only' exited 1 at 'scripts/windows/prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1:2033' with 'The variable '$forwarderRelease' cannot be retrieved because it has not been set.' PowerShell parser inspection of that line showed an ExpandableStringExpressionAst with nested variable expressions '$forwarderRelease' and '$resolvedProject'; because the assertion uses a double-quoted string, backslash does not escape variables in PowerShell, so interpolation happens under Set-StrictMode -Version Latest before Assert-Match runs. Separate literal-regex checks confirmed 'scripts/windows/start-forwarder.ps1:1007-1015' still implements release-first/debug-fallback honestly. The predecessor workaround failure is explained by the tracked assertion text itself: after literal prebinding, the pattern still expects a stray backslash before '$resolvedProject', which the product script does not contain. The causal classification is 'tracked PowerShell test drift' and specifically a 'tracked test expectation and quoting defect', not a 'start-forwarder.ps1' product defect. Minimal owning increment/scope: 'scripts/windows', primarily 'scripts/windows/prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1'; no product repair is required in 'scripts/windows/start-forwarder.ps1'.
blocker.required_authority: Authority to repair the accepted-source Windows compile path in crates/shell and the tracked W2Only assertion drift in scripts/windows/prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1, then run a fresh native-Windows evidence retry on the accepted repaired source.
blocker.handoff_prompt: Repair the Windows compile path in crates/shell starting with cfg alignment across crates/shell/src/repl/async_repl.rs, crates/shell/src/execution/agent_runtime/state_store.rs, and crates/shell/src/execution/orchestrator_world_dispatch.rs, then address any remaining Windows-only compile surfaces revealed by 'cargo build -p shell --lib'. Separately fix scripts/windows/prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1:2033 so the W2Only assertion uses a literal regex with no expandable string interpolation and no spurious backslash before $resolvedProject. After those tracked-source repairs, rerun full native-Windows evidence on the same bound source or its accepted successor.
